errors.text_span: Оста X представлява годините, обозначени като 1, 2 и 3, разположени равномерно по хоризонталната ос.
errors.evidence: The x-axis has no labels or ticks. The description hallucinates the labels "1, 2 и 3".
The description claims the lines have square markers, but the lines in the plot have no markers at all. This error is repeated for all three line descriptions.

errors.text_span: Тя започва при стойност 150 000 в първата година, спада до 120 000 във втората година
errors.evidence: The blue line ("Печалба") starts at approximately 160,000-170,000, not 150,000. It dips to approximately 140,000, not 120,000. Both values are significantly inaccurate.

errors.text_span: Тя започва при стойност 450 000 в първата година
errors.evidence: The orange line ("Оборот") starts at a value visibly higher than 450,000, approximately at 470,000. The reported value is a significant underestimation.
